settings.heading: WhatsApp
settings.text: Chat with us, Mon - Sat. Quick questions and order updates.

settings.heading: Track an order
settings.text: See where your parcel is without waiting for a reply.

settings.question: Where is my order?
settings.answer: Most orders arrive in 3-6 business days. Your tracking link is in your shipping email and in your account under Orders.

settings.question: Can I change or cancel my order?
settings.answer: Email us as soon as possible. If your order has not been packed yet, we can help adjust it.

settings.question: Something arrived damaged
settings.answer: Send us your order number and a photo of the item within 48 hours of delivery so we can make it right.

settings.question: How do returns work?
settings.answer: Most unopened items can be returned within 14 days. Final sale and perishable items are not eligible.

settings.question: Do you sell wholesale?
settings.answer: Yes. Use the wholesale topic in the contact form and our team will reply with next steps.
